title: Austin Approves $1,000 Street Work Budget
summary:
• **Street Improvement Funding**: The city council approved a $1,000 appropriation for extra street labor and maintenance work in Austin.

• **Budget Process**: The funding measure advanced through two readings of the ordinance, with final approval scheduled for the next council meeting.

• **Full Council Support**: All council members present voted unanimously in favor of the street work appropriation.
